policy: No tariff extrapolation. A CPO remains blocked when current deterministic direct-price evidence cannot be obtained from official/public station data, public backend/API, existing app/API reverse engineering, or exact station reconciliation.

blockers.name: Swisscharge
blockers.blocker: 44 public EVSEs still have no deterministic tariff result after direct Swisscharge endpoint retries. Swisscharge officially states that station owners set prices and current end-customer prices are shown per station in the app/adhoc flow.
blockers.resumeCondition: Recover the current adhoc/app backend for the 44 physical references or obtain their station-specific prices.

blockers.name: EPO / Eponet
blockers.blocker: Eponet explicitly lets each infrastructure operator define the QR/ad-hoc charging profile, including start, kWh and blocking fees. Current prices are only exposed through the charger-specific QR flow; no public searchable tariff endpoint was recovered.
blockers.resumeCondition: Obtain Eponet charger IDs/QR URLs or a public Eponet Go/QR backend endpoint that exposes the current station prices.

blockers.name: IWB
blockers.blocker: Six public Basel-Landschaft EVSEs remain. IWB publishes deterministic ad-hoc tariffs for Allmend Basel-Stadt, but not a tariff that can safely be extended to the residual sites in Münchenstein, Pratteln and Muttenz.
blockers.resumeCondition: Obtain station-specific IWB/Swisscharge prices for the six Basel-Landschaft residual EVSEs.

blockers.name: AVIA VOLT
blockers.blocker: AVIA states there is no uniform standard price; price varies by charge point/provider/speed and is shown per point in the AVIA VOLT Suisse app. XAPK reverse engineering identified the Deftpower backend, tenant and APIM-protected route, but the required subscription key/runtime request is not available from the static package.
blockers.resumeCondition: Capture one AVIA VOLT app request with Charles (headers + route, no personal credentials) or otherwise recover the APIM subscription key/runtime guest request.

blockers.name: EBS
blockers.blocker: Sahli remains contradictory. Public station evidence reports contract/RFID only and no ad-hoc price, while other current feed evidence indicates direct-payment capability. The conflict cannot be resolved safely without station-specific current evidence.
blockers.resumeCondition: Obtain current Sahli QR/app/direct-payment screen or EBS/Swisscharge station-specific tariff.

blockers.name: EVTEC-hosted scope
blockers.blocker: The eight EVSEs expose direct-payment capability but EVTEC is the hardware/backend layer; no current public station-specific end-customer tariff was found.
blockers.resumeCondition: Obtain the exact site/operator payment page or current station display/QR tariff for the three sites.

blockers.name: Stadt Dietikon
blockers.blocker: The current EVSE supports direct payment, but no current authoritative charging price is published. The only discovered price rule is historical and is not safe for 2026 production.
blockers.resumeCondition: Obtain a current Stadt Dietikon station tariff/QR/payment page for Bremgartnerstrasse 15.

blockers.name: Elektrizitätswerk Herrliberg
blockers.blocker: The current EVSE supports direct payment but no current authoritative station tariff was found. Electricity retail tariffs cannot be substituted for charging-station pricing.
blockers.resumeCondition: Obtain the current Forchstrasse station QR/payment tariff or an official Elektrizitätswerk Herrliberg charging price.

blockers.name: Partino
blockers.blocker: Partino documents backend billing and public charging services but does not publish the end-customer station price for the three public residual EVSEs. Physical accessibility is not evidence of free charging.
blockers.resumeCondition: Obtain the three station-specific prices from Partino CH backend/Floatbridge or exact payment pages.

blockers.name: eCarUp
blockers.blocker: 294 current owner EVSEs remain after exact normalized connector-ID matching, a dense national API sweep and fail-closed coordinate overlays. eCarUp allows station owners to define their own prices, so unresolved stations cannot inherit a network tariff.
blockers.resumeCondition: Acquire new exact connector IDs/station responses from the eCarUp public API or exact station payment pages for the residual 294 EVSEs.

toolingConstraints.firecrawl: Authenticated Firecrawl balance is exhausted/negative; no further Firecrawl live scrape was available.
toolingConstraints.tinyfish: TinyFish browser automation wallet is negative; free page fetch/search was used where possible, but interactive JS workflows could not be automated.
toolingConstraints.note: These tooling constraints are not used as evidence for pricing; they only explain why interactive app/portal-only surfaces remain unresolved.
